app.name: Super Mario 64
app.coder: sm64-port by mkst & PalindromicBreadLoaf, Wii port by Shank-Mods
app.long_description: Native Wii build of Super Mario 64 (USA), compiled from the sm64 decompilation (sm64-port). No game data is included: put your own US ROM in this folder (apps/sm64) as sm64.z64. Settings: apps/sm64/sm64config.txt (see README.txt).
